units.source_text: 她抓住我的书包，不想交给我。

en.t: She grabbed hold of my schoolbag and would not give it back to me.

units.source_text: 我再三婉拒，她也不答应，说要把我直送到那边。

en.t: I politely refused again and again, but she would not agree, saying she would see me all the way there.

units.source_text: 她反复唠叨着同样的话，小跑着跟在我后头走了一百多米远。

en.t: Repeating the same words over and over, she trotted along behind me for more than a hundred meters.
